test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In an electrical circuit, 'n' number of 10 resistors are connected in parallel. When one of the resistors is eliminated, the overall resistance of the circuit is __________.
solution:
**Explanation:**

If **n identical resistors** (each of resistance **10 Ω**) are connected in parallel, the equivalent resistance is:

Req = 10 / n

When **one resistor is removed**, the number of resistors becomes **(n − 1)**. So the new equivalent resistance becomes:

Req = 10 / (n − 1)

Since the options are given in normalized form (ignoring the constant 10), the correct answer is:

**1 / (n − 1)**
